purpose: Show part-to-whole composition with one ring.

rawDataContract.notes: Rows can contain category and value fields, or the payload can provide explicit items.

modelInstructions: In Mentora use the existing source JSON file via payload.dataSource.path/recordsPath/fields instead of copying rows or writing a conversion script for simple field/date mappings. Read hostExtensions.dataSource for the exact contract; run this concrete script through skill_runner.py execute.
Values must be non-negative and comparable.
Use displayValue for percentages or formatted money; keep value numeric.
Default pie radius should be visually restrained; cap the outer radius around 88px so the circle does not dominate the component.
Default donut ring width should be relatively slim, around 28px or about 30-32% of the outer radius, unless the user explicitly asks for a thicker ring.
Always place the legend below the pie; do not place pie legends on the right side.
Default legends should show only compact inline chips: colored dot plus label, with no numeric value column.
Do not set showLegendValues unless the user explicitly asks the legend to include values or percentages.
When showLegendValues is true, place values close to labels with a compact inline gap; avoid large empty horizontal space between legend labels and values.
Keep the bottom legend as centered horizontal inline chips with wrapping when needed.
Keep the vertical distance between the pie ring and bottom legend compact; avoid tall chart-stage whitespace under the ring.
Fit component height to actual header, ring and bottom legend; never reserve a fixed minimum height beneath the legend.
Do not show a top-right period badge. If relevant, include the period in the semantic title or subtitle.

deprecatedFields.badgeLabel/yearLabel/periodLabel: Accepted in existing payloads for compatibility, no top-right badge rendered.

dataSource.purpose: Pass a verified local JSON file directly; the host maps fields and checks rendered values without model transcription.
dataSource.payload: Keep normal renderer fields (xField, series/yField, axes, visualStyle). Omit data/rows when dataSource is used. No scaling or filling is performed.
dataSource.pieMapping: For pie.py map source fields to label/value; nonnegative finite values and positive total required. Missing values must be handled explicitly upstream, never silently zero-filled.
dataSource.lineOptions: xScale=time for irregular ISO dates/epoch ms; visualStyle.line.curve=step-after|step-before|straight|smooth; missingValuePolicy=gap preserves nulls.
dataSource.receipt: chartValidation reports source hash, rows, per-series valid/missing counts, min/max, first/last observations and axis coverage. Verified chart HTML can be passed to StreamViz chart_artifacts without copying data or drawing SVG coordinates.

hostExtensions.standalone: Direct component CLI still receives ordinary data; host expands dataSource before execution.
